_about: Known-answer test on public data: the jammer ~50 km SW of Shiraz (27.32N 52.87E) seen by NISAR on 8 and 20 Jan 2026 (track 157 ascending, frames 15-16) and absent on 27 Dec 2025 (GPS World, 'Converging on the jammer', 18 May 2026). Those dates exist only as BETA products. Run from nisar/: python -m nisar_rfi run --config validation/shiraz.json --start 2025-12-20 --end 2026-01-21
